cohort: The study included Chinese and Japanese mothers in the United States who gave birth between 1990 and 2000, as identified from birth certificate data.
finding: Compared with Japanese mothers, Chinese mothers were 1 percentage point more likely to undergo C-section when giving birth to boys than when giving birth to girls.
mod_finding: Chinese mothers showed a 1 percentage point higher likelihood of undergoing C-section when delivering boys compared to girls, especially in subgroups with a stronger son preference.
